purpose: Pre-register PHerc0800 Spiral-grid transfer evaluation before any PHerc0800 prediction is produced.

reference_source.caveat: The atlas states these meshes sit within about 5 voxels of the sheet on a small checked sample and are not voxel-accurate surface labels. Treat residuals as comparison evidence, not exact ground truth.

target_sampling.validity_rule: x/y/z are single-channel same-shape arrays; a vertex is valid when z > 0 and x,y,z are finite, matching ScrolIQ TIFXYZ validity.
target_sampling.core_rule: Keep only valid reference vertices whose z coordinate is in that mesh's frozen half-open core.
target_sampling.order: Flatten eligible grid indices in C row-major order.
target_sampling.selection: Let N be eligible vertices and K=min(N,1024). Select ranks floor((i+0.5)*N/K) for i=0..K-1. Target ID is <mesh_uuid>:r<row>:c<col>.

predicted_surface_distance.predicted_grid_format: NPZ or equivalent per-winding grids with arrays shaped (3,H,W) in XYZ base voxels; invalid points have coordinate <=0 according to the producer's convention.
predicted_surface_distance.triangle_rule: A quad is valid when all four vertices are finite and valid. Split each valid quad deterministically into triangles (00,01,11) and (00,11,10).
predicted_surface_distance.distance: Exact Euclidean point-to-triangle distance to triangles whose z extent intersects [core_lo-64, core_hi+64].

winding_index_alignment.reference_data: Only fit-role meshes in the frozen PHerc0800 split.
winding_index_alignment.rule: For each candidate offset, compare sampled fit-role mesh wNNN points to predicted winding w(NNN+offset). Choose the offset minimizing the median of per-mesh median distances. Candidate offsets missing a required predicted winding/core are ineligible. Tie break by smaller absolute offset, then smaller signed offset.
winding_index_alignment.purpose: Resolve only a constant global winding-number convention; no local or held-out-dependent remapping is allowed.

reporting_policy.note: Because the atlas meshes are approximate surfaces rather than voxel-accurate labels, absolute residual thresholds are descriptive. Method promotion must consider residuals, completeness and neighboring-winding behavior together.
